name: Chase Bliss
author: Tone Zone
description: Experimental boutique pedals inspired by Chase Bliss: micro-loopers (temper / bad temper), the bottomless looper, glitch and freeze, spectral codec damage, tape degradation, pitch-stepping delay, the echo collector, multidirectional delay, analog tremolo / phaser / flanger / vibrato, EQ preamps, dual gainstages, a creative compressor and the motorised-fader desktop reverb and echo. Colourful printed art, rows of small knobs and 3-way toggles, tiny DIP switch banks and two footswitches.
